comments:
Scholar writing after 1219 as he quotes the Tshad ma rigs gter (ID:5564) in his epistemological work (ID:4772).
According to [8H6M69W4], he was the 13th abbot of gSang phu. He could be identical to (ID:6301), the 24th abbot of the lower monastery of gSang phu (ID:6158) active in the middle of the 14th century. See [J4L5X9AG]: 432, n. 56.
alternative_names: gsang phu'i gdan rabs sum cu pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan
name: sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan (1)
